info.name: Food Service - Final acceptance
info.description: Run in order. Uses Local environment and an admin account. Creates test data. Expired JWT case requires expired_token; scripts/test-postman.js supplies a genuinely expired signed token locally. Table creation is disabled. Supply final_table_id for a disposable DB test fixture (never a real restaurant table); scripts/test-postman.js provisions one automatically.
